probe_images.description: Measurement_points_temperature_1/2/3.jpg and Measurement_points_velocity_1/2.jpg; every temperature probe is labelled 'name (MODM,C)', every air-speed probe 'name (Port N)'. Which image carries which probe was not recorded by Task 3. Labels were first read by an agent by eye and are now confirmed by the owner (see owner_label_confirmation; the images were hashed by the owner on 2026-11-06). The images sit in the extracted _mv/ folder, which is not in the manifest (O-12).

plot_images.description: temperature.png, power.png (legend 'Rack 1-3', 'Rack 4+6', 'Rack 5'), air_speed.png (m/s), AAU_DC_surrounding_rooms.png and AAU_DC_plan_from_above_with_annotation.png. Hashed by the owner on 2026-11-06.
